activityAttributeStrings: Send one ore more files (zipped) to the HTTP response.
meta.Name: HTTP File Response

inputs.name: ContentType
inputs.Description: The content type of the file to serve. Leave empty to let the system determine the content type.

inputs.name: Filename
inputs.Description: The name of the file to serve. Leave empty to let the system determine the file name.

inputs.name: EntityTag
inputs.Description: The Entity Tag of the file to serve. Leave empty to let the system determine the Entity Tag.

inputs.name: Content
inputs.Description: The file content to serve. Supports various types, such as byte array, stream, string, Uri, Downloadable and a (mixed) array of the aforementioned types.

inputs.name: EnableResumableDownloads
inputs.Description: Whether to enable resumable downloads. When enabled, the client can resume a download if the connection is lost.

inputs.name: DownloadCorrelationId
inputs.Description: The correlation ID of the download used to resume a download. If left empty, the x-download-id header will be used.

activityAttributeStrings: Write a response to the current HTTP response object.
meta.Name: HTTP Response

inputs.name: StatusCode
inputs.Description: The status code to return.

inputs.name: Content
inputs.Description: The content to write back. String values will be sent as-is, while objects will be serialized to a JSON string. Byte arrays and streams will be sent as files.

inputs.name: ContentType
inputs.Description: The content type to write when sending the response.

inputs.name: ResponseHeaders
inputs.Description: The headers to send along with the response.
